$comment: Decision record written by the composer-package skill. Read this before re-running it in this directory.

language.note: Prompts and conversation in German; all generated documentation and code comments in English, as is customary for an open source addon.

vision.summary: A Statamic addon that automatically commits — and optionally pushes — content changes made in the control panel.
vision.differentiator: The equivalent core feature is Pro only. statamic/spock is archived, Gitamic is paid and manual, git-auto-push is a blunt 24h cron. This is free, MIT and event driven, and it runs on Statamic Solo.
vision.consumer: Statamic sites keeping flat-file content in git
vision.distribution: Private GitHub repository for now. Packagist and the Statamic marketplace are a later, deliberate step.

identity.versionStrategy: tags only, no version key in composer.json

architecture.namingConvention: role suffix per class: Contract, DTO, Manager, Repository, Builder, Resolver, Strategy, Dispatcher, Runner, Check, Job, Command, Exception. Forbidden: Factory, Provider (except ServiceProvider), Helper, Util, Handler.
principles: contract-first, singletons bound in ServiceProvider, constructor injection only
no inheritance except AddonServiceProvider and the exception hierarchy
no associative arrays between classes — DTOs and enums only
exactly one process gate (Services\Process\ProcessRunner) and one git gate (Repositories\GitRepository)
config() only in ServiceProvider and GitSyncConfigResolver
nothing throws into a control panel save request

keyDecisions.debounce: trailing edge, 60s default, cache-marker based; degrades to NullDebounceRepository without lock support
keyDecisions.dataSafety: the cache is timing only. What gets committed is read from git status at run time; a scheduled safety net (*/15) commits whatever the event path missed, so a cache outage costs a delay, never a commit.
keyDecisions.concurrency: Laravel job middleware (Skip, WithoutOverlapping, ThrottlesExceptions) plus SyncLock for the console and scheduler paths
keyDecisions.failurePolicy: SyncManager::handleFailure() only. Retryability comes from FailureType, not from message matching.
keyDecisions.jobOptions: SyncJobOptionsDTO travels with the job because Laravel calls middleware() without the container

documentation.readme: full: why, install, quickstart, how it works, comparison table, roadmap

releases.changelog: hand written, Keep a Changelog, entry lands in the same pull request as the change
releases.backwardCompatibility: below 1.0 Composer treats every minor as breaking (^0.1 excludes 0.2). Stated in CHANGELOG.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.

context7: Laravel queue job middleware (Skip, WithoutOverlapping, ThrottlesExceptions)
Laravel Process facade, faking and preventStrayProcesses
Laravel atomic cache locks and the stores that support them
localVendor: vendor/statamic/cms/src/Events/ — every event class name checked against the installed version
vendor/statamic/cms/src/Providers/AddonServiceProvider.php — Subscribers/ is the auto-registered folder, config file must be named after the addon slug
composer update --dry-run — Statamic 5 and 6 both resolve, so the CI matrix needs no exclusions
constraintsVerifiedVia.cleanRoom: vendor/statamic/cms/src/Git/ was never opened. Statamic licence clause 4 forbids reusing its code; behaviour was reimplemented from the public documentation and public events only.

verification.composerValidate: valid; the 'could not detect root package version' notice is expected in a repository without tags

fileInventory.note: Paths only. Per-file hashes were deliberately omitted: this is the first run, everything here was generated in one pass, and git already tracks every subsequent change more accurately than a stored hash would.

openPoints: Ask Statamic whether a free addon committing on content events via public events is acceptable, before the repository goes public.
Decide when to publish on Packagist and list on the Statamic marketplace.
Roadmap v2: pull-request strategy (branch + PR instead of a direct push).
